IntroducedBillHeader.Sponsors: House Committee on Appropriations (originally sponsored by Representatives Hatfield, Pearson, Blake and Sump; by request of Department of Fish and Wildlife)

Bill.BriefDescription: Allowing the department of fish and wildlife to allocate certain forfeited moneys for coastal groundfish management and research.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to the department of fish and wildlife's authorityto allocate certain moneys; amending RCW 77.12.177; and adding a newsection to chapter 77.12 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 77.12.177 and 2001 c 253 s 16 are each amended to readas follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) Except as provided in this title, state and county officersreceiving the following moneys shall deposit them in the state generalfund: (a) The sale of commercial licenses required under this title,except for licenses issued under RCW 77.65.490; and (b) Moneys received for damages to food fish or shellfish. (2) The director shall make weekly remittances to the statetreasurer of moneys collected by the department. (3) All fines and forfeitures collected or assessed by a districtcourt for a violation of this title or rule of the department shall beremitted as provided in chapter 3.62 RCW. (4) Proceeds from the sale of food fish or shellfish taken in testfishing conducted by the department((, to the extent that these p. 1 SHB 2626proceeds exceed the estimates in the budget approved by thelegislature, may be allocated as unanticipated receipts under RCW43.79.270)) shall be deposited in the fish management and researchaccount created in section 2 of this act to reimburse the departmentfor unanticipated costs for test fishing operations ((in excess of theallowance in the budget approved by the legislature)). (5) Proceeds from the sale of salmon carcasses and salmon eggs fromstate general funded hatcheries by the department of generaladministration shall be deposited in the regional fisheries enhancementgroup account established in RCW 77.95.090. (6) Moneys received by the commission under RCW 77.12.039, to theextent these moneys exceed estimates in the budget approved by thelegislature, may be allocated as unanticipated receipts under RCW43.79.270. Allocations under this subsection shall be made only forthe specific purpose for which the moneys were received, unless themoneys were received in settlement of a claim for damages to food fishor shellfish, in which case the moneys may be expended for theconservation of these resources. (7) Proceeds from the sale of herring spawn on kelp fisherylicenses by the department((, to the extent those proceeds exceedestimates in the budget approved by the legislature, may be allocatedas unanticipated receipts under RCW 43.79.270)) shall be deposited inthe fish management and research account created in section 2 of thisact. Allocations under this subsection shall be made only for herringmanagement, enhancement, and enforcement. (8) Moneys received by the department from the forfeiture ofcoastal groundfish in excess of vessel trip or cumulative limits shallbe deposited in the fish management and research account created insection 2 of this act. Allocations under this subsection shall be madeonly for coastal groundfish management and research.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 77.12 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The fish management and research account is created in the custodyof the state treasurer. Revenues to the account are received by thedepartment under RCW 77.12.177 (4), (7), and (8). Expenditures fromthis account may be made only for purposes for which the moneys were SHB 2626 p. 2 received. Only the director of the department or the director'sdesignee has authority to make expenditures from the account, and noappropriation is required for expenditure.
